summary: Recent discussions in the Parquet community focus on extending the format’s logical types, refining its versioning strategy, and expanding its encoding options.  A proposal to add a VECTOR logical type for fixed‑length numeric vectors was presented, while a new versioning scheme distinguishing add‑everywhere changes from compatibility level updates was outlined.  Contributors are also being invited to develop and integrate additional encodings such as pcode, FSST, and PFOR.

highlights.text: Proposal to add a logical type VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR) for fixed‑length numeric vectors in Parquet.

highlights.text: Introduction of a two‑category Parquet versioning scheme—add‑everywhere and compatibility level—to accelerate feature rollout while maintaining reader correctness.
Call for community contributors to add new encodings to Parquet, highlighting existing work on pcode, FSST, and PFOR.
